messages:
nicole: Quick coordination thread — proposing a small weekend window to exercise the rolling quant toggle. Plan: Sat 02:00 UTC start, flip quant_profile from fp16 -> int8 for 5% canary, observe 2h, then scale to 20% if all signals green. Also want to run a separate, limited int4 path for a small latency-sensitive cohort (internal flag: quant_experiment_int4). Need SRE/watch, QA guardrails, and a quick PR review for the feature-gate change.

sanjay: +1 on weekend timing. Can we make the canary 3% instead of 5%? we've seen noisy stats on 5% before. Also add a hard abort condition on p95 latency > 1.5x baseline.

nicole: Good call — 3% makes sense. We'll set the abort: p95 RQ latency increases by >50% OR error rate jumps >0.2% absolute over baseline. Will add those to the rollout script.

jin: I can review the PR tonight. What exact metrics dashboards should SRE watch? pinging @elena for oncall availability.

elena: I'm oncall that weekend. I'll be watching the main inference dashboard + the quant-regressions panel (token latencies, error rate, tail spikes). Set an alert for: token-generation-error-rate > 0.15% for 5min and p95 > baseline*1.5 for 3min.

max: FYI, the feature flag CLI is `rwctl feature toggle set quant_profile --value=int8 --audience=3% --meta="run=weekend-quant-canary"`. For the int4 experiment it's `rwctl feature toggle set quant_experiment_int4 --value=on --audience=0.5%` (small cohort). I'll paste both into the runbook.

nicole: adding commands here for the runbook — please sanity-check:
```
# canary int8 3%
rwctl feature toggle set quant_profile --value=int8 --audience=3% --stagger=5m --meta="run=weekend-quant-canary"
# small int4 cohort 0.5%
rwctl feature toggle set quant_experiment_int4 --value=on --audience=0.5% --stagger=10m --meta="run=weekend-quant-int4"
# rollback (global)
rwctl feature toggle set quant_profile --value=fp16 --audience=100% --force
```

jin: commands look good. For stagger times let's keep them conservative. Also include a step to pin model variant to quant-safe model before flipping (to avoid mixed kernel regressions).

max: added pin step to the runbook: `rwctl model pin --model=curie-quant-safe --since=now` before toggles.

elena: I'll create temporary dashboards showing delta vs baseline (p50/p95/p99, error rate, token-throughput). Also enabling a short-lived logging hook to sample 0.01% of requests for quality checks.

ops-bot: Deployment window reservation created: 2028-04-02 02:00 UTC -> 04:00 UTC. Incident channel #incidents will be auto-subscribed.

nicole: Thanks. Two last asks: (1) Sanjay — can you confirm the A/B assignment logic will respect the 0.5% int4 micro-cohort (no overlap with other experiments)? (2) Jin — please land the PR by EOD so we have the feature gate on main.

sanjay: I'll validate audience hashing rules and confirm no overlap. Will post results in this thread.

jin: PR queued, just one test flake to fix, should be merged in ~3h.

nicole: Awesome. If anyone finds anything risky, call abort and follow rollback command above. Otherwise we'll proceed but hold scaling to 20% until we have 3h of clean signals. :thumbsup:
